evals.prompt: Add KCNA certification coverage to this public DevOps Question database. Map the current official curriculum, reuse shared questions where appropriate, and add original gaps.
evals.expected_output: A KCNA issue and map that use the official curriculum, canonical kcna tags, source-verified original Questions, catalog integration, tests, CI, and a clear close/review outcome.
expectations: Uses an official KCNA curriculum source and records its review date.
Uses canonical shared Questions rather than duplicating fundamentals.
Requires question-verifier source metadata and complementary blog reading.
Requires catalog, local tests, GitHub Actions, and issue lifecycle evidence.

evals.prompt: A new Kubernetes networking certification is still changing. Create practice coverage without copying exam questions and leave it ready for maintainer review.
evals.expected_output: An original, review-gated certification workflow that maps the latest official objectives, handles an evolving program, validates Questions and discovery, and does not prematurely close the issue.
expectations: Avoids real or confidential exam-content reproduction.
Rechecks a changing official curriculum before final CI.
Keeps shared Questions canonical and uses certification tags.
Leaves review-gated work open with explicit reviewer instructions.

evals.prompt: The CKS map exists but links several untagged questions and the website omits two new question cards. Repair the certification coverage task.
evals.expected_output: A repair plan and implementation that aligns map links and certification tags, updates the catalog, adds durable automated checks, runs CI, and reports the issue lifecycle outcome.
expectations: Checks that every mapped Question carries the certification tag.
Adds every active Question exactly once to the .html catalog.
Extends repository validation for durable certification invariants.
Does not close the issue until GitHub Actions passes.
